title: mri_seghead
description: Binarizes an input volume to identify the head's voxels.

fill_value.description: Fill value for binarizing the head (default 255).
fill_value.title: Fill Value

fhi_value.description: FHI value used in type change operation (default 0.999).
fhi_value.title: FHI Value

thresh1_value.description: Threshold value for detecting the skin (e.g., 20).
thresh1_value.title: Threshold 1

thresh2_value.description: Threshold value for the final binarization (e.g., 20).
thresh2_value.title: Threshold 2

threshold.description: Single threshold value applied to both thresh1 and thresh2.
threshold.title: Combined Threshold

nhitsmin_value.description: Minimum number of consecutive hits needed to identify skin (default 2).
nhitsmin_value.title: Minimum Hits

hvoldat_file.description: File to write the volume of the head in mm3 to an ASCII file.
hvoldat_file.title: Head Volume Output File

signal_behind_head.description: Consider signals behind the head in the binarization process.
signal_behind_head.title: Signal Behind Head Flag

rescale.description: Rescale the input when converting to uchar.
rescale.title: Rescale Input Flag

fill_holes_islands.description: Fill holes and remove islands in the binary volume.
fill_holes_islands.title: Fill Holes and Remove Islands Flag

seed_point.description: Seed point specified by column, row, slice for filling operation.
seed_point.title: Seed Point

or_mask_file.description: Mask file to include voxels in the binarization process.
or_mask_file.title: OR Mask File

gdiag_option.description: Optional diagnostic option for internal use.
gdiag_option.title: Gdiag Option
